pkgmetadata.longdescription: Omarchy app reference: upstream omarchy-pkgs pkgbuilds/dotnet-core-bin splits the Microsoft SDK tarballs across six sub-packages; on Gentoo the SDK is packaged as dev-dotnet/dotnet-sdk-bin (::gentoo, source-built dev-dotnet/dotnet-sdk also exists), which this metapackage pulls in. Ships no content itself.
